name: Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation
program: Gulbenkian Prize for Humanity (the Prize has no public call; climate, energy, water and environment calls of the Foundation are read from its grants list)
collect_note: Reads the Foundation's public WordPress grants list (wp-json grant type, every published call with its application start and end dates) twice a day and keeps the climate, energy, water, agriculture and environment calls. The Gulbenkian Prize for Humanity itself has no public call for applications (nominations only, the page publishes statistics and winners), so nothing from the Prize is collected; the funder's own calls are the best live source that exists.
evidence: Retested 2026-11-12 from desktop: adapter_check ok true, 5 items kept of 52 (all closed; newest Comunidades de Energia, own page shows end 16 set 2026 12:00, matches). wp-json/wp/v2/grant 200 application/json (Cloudflare), prize page 200, sitemap_index 200 (grant/program/funding_type sitemaps), robots 200. Dead channels: /en/feed 500, ?rest_route=/wp/v2/grant 401, wp/v2/types and wp/v2/program 401, no __NEXT_DATA__, no XHR endpoints. Prize page has no call text, so a page watch adds nothing over the grants list. Edge run on 2026-11-12 got HTTP 403 (funders.last_status 403, last_ok_at null, consecutive_failures 1, fetchability bot_protected) while the same URLs return 200 from a desktop IP: Cloudflare edge IP block, not a moved page or changed markup. Rerun 2026-11-13 (discovery-2026-11-13): every Gulbenkian host is the same Cloudflare zone (gulbenkian.pt, cdn.gulbenkian.pt 403 even locally, gulbenkian.org and gulbenkian.org.uk only redirect to gulbenkian.pt; MyGulbenkian, candidaturas, apoios, api and Fluxx/Submittable/SmartSimple hosts do not resolve or 404). Alt formats on the same host: /feed/?post_type=grant is 200 RSS locally but holds only the 10 newest posts, no deadlines, and adapter_check with the climate filter gives 0 items; /en/bolsas-lista/ and /en/grants/ listings are JS shells (items load by XHR from the blocked wp-json); grant-sitemap.xml has URLs only. No channel on a non-Cloudflare host exists; not re-applied.
